patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I was grinding metal without goggles because goggles 'aren't cool.' Breaking news: goggles are extremely cool. My right eye won't open and it's crying without my permission.
presentation.triageNote: 23-year-old male, right-eye foreign-body sensation after grinding metal without goggles, vision intact.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 4 / Fast Track is appropriate because the patient is stable and is expected to need a focused eye examination and treatment resource.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This is a stable eye complaint after high-speed metal work that requires a focused ocular examination and likely foreign-body treatment.
clinical.acuityReason: Vision is reported intact and there is no presented evidence of globe rupture or systemic instability, but the metal-on-metal mechanism requires careful assessment.
expectedResources: Slit-lamp evaluation and possible foreign-body removal
keyFindings: Tearing and difficulty opening the eye
teachingPoints: High-speed eye injuries require assessment for penetration before a superficial foreign body is removed.
The eyelid should be everted and vision documented during the examination.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: A superficial foreign body could be removed after examination, with rust-ring assessment, topical treatment, eye follow-up, and discharge if penetration is excluded.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: 23-year-old guy in a dusty work t-shirt
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting, tilting his head, cupping his right eye
aiImageGeneration.expression: squinting hard, one eye clamped shut and watering
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: an Asian 23-year-old guy in a dusty work t-shirt, on the same blue clinic chair. Pose: sitting, tilting his head, cupping his right eye. Expression: squinting hard, one eye clamped shut and watering. Clearly visible: right eye squeezed shut, a tear streak down that cheek. Overall uncomfortable but stable. No text, no logos.
